prompt:
Internal planning draft, public-distributable input only.

Produce a plain-text reconciliation checklist for the Deep programme as of 2026-11-13, in four sections: (1) decisions already taken and still unexecuted, (2) decisions still pending, (3) smallest next actions, (4) risks if skipped. Cover exactly these named items with a one-line acceptance test each: goal source-ancestry correction receipt, status.json freshness, relay cost ledger reconciliation, Linear snapshot export, 11-13 daily card split, QWEN-FOUR-RULINGS pending file, native-first dispatch audit.

Rules: do not invent commit ids, run ids, balances, dates or executor metadata; write unknown where a value is unknown. Do not claim anything was deployed, accepted or paid. Under 400 words, no JSON envelope, no tools or external action.
